# Required runtimes
DSH
Git
Node.js LTS and npm
Python 3.x

# FireEye/Honglian integration
Authorized FireEye/Honglian forensic software
The matching `ges` CLI or vendor-provided forensic CLI

# Core forensic tools
FireEye/Honglian forensic software and licensed components
Volatility 3
MemProcFS
The Sleuth Kit: fls, mmls, icat, fsstat
Wireshark and tshark
7-Zip
ExifTool
SQLite command-line tools or DB Browser for SQLite

# Recommended additions
Plaso/log2timeline
YARA
ALEAPP/iLEAPP
Foremost or Scalpel
Bulk Extractor
JADX
Ghidra or IDA Pro
